Hi there! You can trim your notification volume right away from your own profile:

1. Open **Profile → Notifications**.
2. Turn off the types you don’t need – e.g., **Mention**, **Status change**, and **Digest** emails.
3. Keep **Assignment** notifications on if you only want alerts for items assigned to you.

These changes take effect immediately and only affect your account; no admin changes are required. Let me know if you need any more help!
